featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

featured_reviews.name: Digvijay Chakraborty
featured_reviews.review_text: I lived here from March 2022 to May 2023. Good place. Rooms are clean and you can ask the housekeeping staff to clean the rooms whenever required. They are present in hostel from morning 7 am to 4 pm. Most of the rooms are double occupancy rooms. Just a few rooms in Hostel 195 third floor are triple occupancy.There are washing machines and fridges on every floor, to be shared by all the people living on that floor. Washrooms are clean. Most of the rooms are AC rooms, just a few rooms in the 193 hostel are non-AC. Hostel 195 is better than 193 in terms of room size. You can take any of the buses from the nearby Sion Bus Stop to Kapol Niwas/Ruia Bus Stop, it costs Rs. 5 to reach Welingkar Institute of Management. Also, there is a Dosa stall just outside the Hostel, Mani Uncle's Dosa, who is available from 7am to 3pm. Dosas are quite cheap and tasty (Rs.20- Paper Dosa, Rs. 30- Masala Dosa etc.) so breakfast is taken care of. The Hostel charges only include only room charges, and there is no food provided, so food arrangements have to be made by the person staying themselves.
